sources.title: Wan AI: Leading AI Video Generation Model
sources.snippet: Wan is an AI creative platform. It aims to lower the barrier to creative work using artificial intelligence, offering features like text-to-image, image-to-image, text-to-video, image-to-video, and image editing.

sources.title: Wan: Open and Advanced Large-Scale Video Generative Models
sources.snippet: This report presents Wan, a comprehensive and open suite of video foundation models designed to push the boundaries of video generation.
